title: Align shadow terminology with parallel QC semantics
user_business_goal: Clarify that shadow is the operating lane where the app runs in parallel with real QC, not a fake application mode. QC-facing HMI text and operator-visible health/status should describe the product as real review-only / parallel QC evidence until camera, model, SOP, and release gates approve production authority.
out_of_scope: renaming existing endpoint paths, schema fields, audit fields, historical queue records, or contract versions
live camera capture, camera SDK loading, camera credentials, GPU/hardware validation, or hardware readiness approval
raw media, raw datasets, customer/factory data, notebooks, model weights, TensorRT engines, model binaries, model deserialization, or inference runtime
request-supplied file paths for replay/spec/calibration/model selection
production deploy/release, secrets, tokens, provider credentials, destructive migrations, production data migration, billing, legal/compliance behavior, or security boundary change
product spec approval, QC/SOP tolerance approval, model promotion approval, production PASS/NG authority, or production auto-reject behavior
acceptance_criteria: HMI visible/operator-facing text no longer labels the application lane as Shadow Model or Detector shadow status.
HMI uses Parallel QC, Model Assist, and Review-only wording for artifact readiness and detector bridge status while preserving existing internal IDs/endpoints/contracts.
HMI maps internal task/action names such as shadow_observation_review and submit_shadow_observation_payload into operator-readable parallel-QC labels.
Health/domain bootstrap state names distinguish implemented parallel-QC SOP logic from production authority and avoid implying a fake or app-only shadow product.
Documentation explicitly defines shadow as parallel QC operation beside the human QC process, not an application substitute or production approval.
Existing detector, feedback, artifact, replay, HMI, product CI, and full repo checks pass.
required_checks: Browser smoke: open /hmi locally and confirm QC-facing text shows Parallel QC / Model Assist / Review-only without raw shadow task labels.

memory_preflight.query: Flange QC v2 shadow terminology, parallel QC operating lane, HMI operator wording, health state authority.
retrieved_decisions: Shadow is an operating lane for running beside human QC and collecting evidence.
App output remains review-only without production authority until product spec, QC/SOP, model, hardware, and release gates pass.
Internal contract fields and endpoints may retain shadow names for compatibility.
retrieved_lessons: QC-facing tablet text should not expose internal lane names when simpler operational wording exists.
Changing visible labels should preserve existing contracts, endpoint paths, audit fields, and automation wiring.
memory_preflight.conflicts_found: Operator-visible HMI labels and health state strings used shadow wording that could imply an app mode instead of a parallel-QC operating lane.

rollback_note: Revert the FQV2-052 PR to restore prior HMI labels, health state strings, tests, and docs. No data, secrets, deployment, hardware, model, migration, or release state is changed.
